# Kumanga

> Kumanga is a free, open-source (MIT), local-first AI manga harness: a studio
> that runs in the browser where AI generates reusable assets — characters,
> poses, expressions, backgrounds — and a non-destructive editor composes them
> into manga pages the creator controls. Bring your own API key (Gemini,
> OpenAI-compatible, or custom endpoint). No account, no subscription, no data
> harvesting. v0.1 is live with 991 passing automated tests including 98
> dedicated security tests. Independent project by BotTony329, funded via a
> rewards-based crowdfunding campaign on Pozible (until 29 September 2026)
> plus GoFundMe donations.

Last updated: 2026-08-24

## Website

- [Home / product page](https://kumanga-website.vercel.app/): what Kumanga is, features, how the Manga Agent works, demo videos, sample manga pages, roadmap, FAQ, and how to support the launch.

## Try it

- [Live studio (v0.1 preview)](https://mangaharness.vercel.app): the running application — no account needed.

## Source & demos

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/BotTony329/mangaharness): MIT-licensed source code for the harness.
- [Demo: character relation system](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=t0AOxLiDGxA): interaction poses that respect defined character relationships without character drift.
- [Demo: all elements are assets](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=O1h57FN3uns): every element on a page is a reusable, movable, reframable asset.

## Support the launch

- [Pozible campaign](https://www.pozible.com/project/launching-ai-manga-harness-1): rewards-based crowdfunding, all-or-nothing, AU$5,000 goal, live 23 August – 29 September 2026. Funds PDF, webtoon-strip and print-ready export, multi-project management, and collaboration. Reward tiers from AU$10 (README credit) to AU$500 (sponsor).
- [GoFundMe fundraiser](https://gofund.me/91d807ee1): direct donations toward the same roadmap.
